name: Park Jae-hyun
bio:
Park Jae-hyun's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, through a fascination with the vibrant liveries of racing cars he saw on television as a child. He honed his skills in a local auto body shop, quickly mastering the art of color matching and paint application. His precision and attention to detail caught the eye of a karting team owner, leading to his first role in motorsport.

At Sodi Kart Factory, Park approaches his work with a blend of meticulous planning and problem-solving. He is known for his ability to quickly assess and rectify any imperfections in the paintwork, ensuring that every kart leaving the shop reflects the team's commitment to excellence. He is particularly adept at replicating complex designs and applying protective coatings that withstand the rigors of racing.

Park's dedication to his craft and his pragmatic approach have made him a valuable asset to the team. He consistently delivers high-quality results under pressure and is always willing to share his knowledge and expertise with others. Park firmly believes that a flawless paint job is not just about aesthetics, but also about instilling confidence in the drivers and representing the team's professionalism.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave on top
physical.description: He has a lean build and often wears safety glasses perched on his forehead.

quirks: Always meticulously cleans his spray gun immediately after use.
Has a small collection of miniature racing helmets on his workbench.
Uses a specific brand of Korean green tea to clean his hands, claiming it removes paint residue better than anything else.
